entries.title: Psalms 129:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of degrees.>> Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say: {Many...: or, Much}

entries.title: Psalms 129:2
segments: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me. {Many...: or, Much}

entries.title: Psalms 129:3
segments: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.

entries.title: Psalms 129:4
segments: The LORD [is] righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 129:5
segments: ¶Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 129:6
segments: Let them be as the grass [upon] the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:

words.text: Let them be as the grass

entries.title: Psalms 129:7
segments: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.

entries.title: Psalms 129:8
segments: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD [be] upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD.

words.text: Neither do they which go by
